purpose: One-time untouched-event observed-water evaluation; no fitting, threshold selection or model promotion on final labels.

reporting.common_support: known source label, both sensors valid, and both optical index denominators defined
comparisons: per-event and two-event macro IoU/F1 at frozen thresholds
M5 per-event Brier, ECE and retained coverage against fixed scaling and calibration prevalence
reporting.uncertainty: Two final events are too few for a narrow generalisation interval. Do not bootstrap pixels or claim universal transfer.
reporting.water_semantics: Source observed-water label, not event-specific flood water, road closure or passability.
